parameters.name: Domain
parameters.description: The accelerated domain name whose ICP filing status you want to update.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the Global Accelerator (GA) instance is deployed. Set the value to **cn-hangzhou**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ga update-domain-state --domain www.example.com --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
